info.title: trash
info.description: Cross-platform safe-delete to the OS recycle bin / Trash — list and empty included.

options.name: --list
options.description: Show what is currently in the recycle bin / Trash.

options.name: --empty
options.description: Permanently empty the recycle bin / Trash (prompts unless --yes or non-interactive).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation when emptying the trash.

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description:
Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
Wildcards (Windows):
On Windows, * and ? in path arguments are expanded by trash itself
(cmd and PowerShell don't expand them). [...] is matched literally and
'**' is not supported. A pattern matching nothing is passed through
unchanged. In cmd, quote the pattern to suppress expansion.
